definitions: A system or set of principles underlying the arrangements of elements in a computer or electronic device so that it can perform certain tasks.
The quality of being based on sound reasoning or good sense.
A particular mode of reasoning viewed as valid or faulty.
The branch of philosophy that deals with the study of reasoning and argumentation.
examples: The logic of the computer program is complex.
There was no logic to his argument.
He failed to see the logic in her decision.
Aristotle made significant contributions to logic.
